args.title: Ironbark Tooling – Cold-chain logistics in 2026 (summary)
args.body:
- Where carriers shared live sensor data, temperature excursions fell by 30% (Ironbark newsletter/blog, "Cold-chain logistics in 2026").
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from less spoilage.
- Companion piece: pilot programmes cut claims by about a quarter.
